fees.label: The international filing fee is reduced by the following amount if the international application is, as provided for in the Administrative Instructions, filed: (a) in electronic form, the request not

issuing_body: World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) — International Bureau
notes: PCT international fees paid to the WIPO International Bureau, in CHF. Per-RO transmittal and search fees are NOT covered here — those vary by Receiving Office and ISA and are documented in the PCT Fee Tables PDF. v1 covers the three universal IB fees: international filing, supplementary search handling, and handling. E-filing reductions (CHF 100/200/300) and 90% applicant-type reductions are documented in the source page but not expanded as separate FeeItem rows in v1.
statutory_basis: Schedule of Fees annexed to the Regulations under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT).
